ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup did fire (swing low in, momentum turned up), but it's LATE — price is already extended above the cycle low (formed ~23 day(s) ago @ 10.15) and overbought (daily RSI 75, 3-day 82 & weekly 77). A momentum cross is a LAGGING confirmation: after a vertical run it only triggers once the move is mature, so the bottoming entry has already passed. This is a chase, not a fresh buy.
ladder.next: Don't initiate here. Wait for a pullback toward the 10-day average — or the next daily-cycle low to set up — for a lower-risk entry; hold if you're already long.
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: MIXED — weekly momentum positive (investor cycle week 20 · daily cycle day 62).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a high. Bigger picture (no clear trend): mixed.

entry.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended and overbought (daily RSI 75, 3-day 82 & weekly 77). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.

ladder.early_note: ⚡ Early topping signs (heads-up): StochRSI dropped out of overbought. These anticipate a high BEFORE confirmation — a heads-up to protect gains, not a sell trigger yet.

ladder.next_zh: 此处不宜建仓。等待回调至 10 日均线附近——或下一个日线周期低点构筑成形——以获得风险更低的入场；若已持有则可继续持有。

ladder.liq_line: Macro headwind: US net liquidity is contracting — buy setups have historically had worse odds and deeper drawdowns here, so demand extra confirmation and smaller size. An odds edge, not a forecast.

ladder.eq_label: Entry quality: solid exit setting up (-35)
ladder.eq_label_zh: 入场质量：稳健离场构筑中（-35）
ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

headline.en: Long-duration name into a restrictive, rising-real-rate regime — rate-neutral.
headline.zh: 长久期标的进入偏紧、实际利率上行的环境——利率中性。

detail.en: Own orthogonal rate (TLT) beta +0.21 ± 0.14 — medium precision. Sector anchor (XLRE) reads long-duration (+0.35). Inflation-neutral.
detail.zh: 自身正交利率（TLT）beta +0.21 ± 0.14——精度中。 板块锚（XLRE）为长久期（+0.35）。 通胀中性。

caveat.en: Single-name secondary betas are noisy — trust the portfolio aggregate, not any one stock's rate beta (measured out-of-sample persistence ≈ 0.36).
caveat.zh: 单一个股的次级beta噪声很大——应相信组合层面的汇总，而非任何单只股票的利率beta（实测样本外持续性约0.36）。
